title: TurnLabel
description: Spec version 1. One label on one turn, the training and bench record for the search-assist head (ROUTER-BUILD-01a). This is the one place the label spec lives; the trainer and every bench dataset cite its version. utterance_ref and prev_turn_ref are pointers to stored turn rows (or to a bench row id), never hashes of text, and are never shown on admin pages or in logs. Household rows keep their text only on the hub. memory_worthy is out: it belongs to the memory judge's own dataset.

utterance_ref.description: Pointer to the stored turn row (or bench row id) holding the utterance. Never a hash of the text.

prev_turn_ref.description: Pointer to the previous turn row, or null when there is none. Never a hash of the text.

tool_need.description: A set over the ten tools plus none. ["none"] means no tool; none never appears beside another name.

search_scope.description: The websearch scope argument the turn needs (KS-BENCH-01), or null when it needs no search.

follow_up_carry.description: Whether the previous turn's topic carries into this one.

explicit.description: True when the person asked outright, false when the need is implied.

side_effect.description: Whether the turn changes state (timer, reminder creation, other state).

author.description: Author or generator of the utterance.
